subject: Request to reschedule demo — Horizon Medical site visit conflict
messages:
From: Karen Soto <karen.soto@horizonmed.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Horizon Medical Demo Coord <demo-coord@horizonmed.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: Request to reschedule demo originally Nov 10 — site visit conflict

Hi Rishi,

Quick heads up — our leadership asked the operations team to run a facility site visit the week of Nov 8–12, and a few of the people who were planning to join the Nov 10 demo will be onsite that week (including Dr. Patel and our procurement lead). Would you be open to moving our live walkthrough to the week after (starting Monday Nov 15)?

We'd prefer a morning Pacific time slot if possible. Right now the options that look workable for us are:
- Thu Nov 18, 10:00 AM PT
- Fri Nov 19, 9:00 AM PT

If neither works, we can do the demo on Nov 10 and record it for the execs, but they'd rather attend live. Apologies for the late notice — the site visit schedule shifted this week.

Thanks,
Karen Soto
Director of Clinical Ops
Horizon Medical

--
Horizon Medical
Phone: (415) 555-0134
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Karen Soto <karen.soto@horizonmed.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Horizon Medical Demo Coord <demo-coord@horizonmed.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request to reschedule demo originally Nov 10 — site visit conflict

Hi Karen — thanks for the heads up and totally understood. We can absolutely move the walkthrough so your execs can join live.

Nov 18 at 10:00 AM PT works for our team; Nov 19 at 9:00 AM PT is also available if that is a better fit. I've looped in Marissa (who will lead the demo if I am on the road) and our ops coordinator to update the invite.

I've attached an updated agenda (redwood-demo-agenda-v2.pdf) and will send a new calendar invite once we confirm. Please let me know which date you prefer.

If you prefer Nov 10 and a recorded session, we can do that too — just say the word.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com | (650) 555-0199
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 09:25:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request to reschedule demo — coordinate coverage

Marissa / Steph — forwarding Karen's note. Heads-up: I'm speaking at a partner field event on Nov 18 and will be traveling that morning though I could join from the road if needed — better for customer experience if one of you runs the demo.

Can Marissa lead the session on Nov 18 at 10:00 AM PT if Karen confirms? If Karen picks Nov 19 we can keep it on my calendar and I will lead.

Action items:
- Marissa: take lead on the demo if we confirm Nov 18. I'll provide talking points and a short script for Q&A.
- Stephanie: please create the new calendar invite (horizon-calendar-invite.ics) and include the attached agenda. Add HubSpot link to the description and set the meeting to 60 minutes with a 15-minute buffer after.

Quick notes for the runbook:
- 0–10m: introductions + customer objectives (Karen)
- 10–40m: live walkthrough (Marissa)
- 40–55m: deployment and pricing discussion (me, remotely)
- 55–60m: next steps / mutual action plan

Thanks — I owe you both coffee.

Rishi
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Karen Soto <karen.soto@horizonmed.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request to reschedule demo originally Nov 10 — site visit conflict

Hi Karen — happy to take the Nov 18 slot. 10:00 AM PT on Thu Nov 18 is confirmed on our side unless you prefer Nov 19 at 9:00 AM PT instead.

I've attached the updated agenda (redwood-demo-agenda-v2.pdf) and included a calendar invite (horizon-calendar-invite.ics) — you should see a new meeting in your calendar shortly. The invite links to our HubSpot record and the demo runbook.

Quick recap of attendees we have on our side: Me (Marissa) — demo lead; Rishi — product & pricing; Stephanie — ops; plus one engineer for Q&A. If anything changes on your side, just reply and we'll adapt.

Looking forward to it,

Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
